mode: actuated position-controlled MuJoCo SO-101 with mj_step; geometric grasp gate then mocap attachment

model.name: Beer-Lambert teaching model
model.assumptions: A=epsilon*c*l; epsilon=ln(10) L mol^-1 cm^-1, c=0.30/0.52 mol L^-1, l=1 cm; illustrative, uncalibrated.
model.sensor: rendered vial material RGB proxy converted to optical density; separate from analytical prediction, not physical photometer or camera pixel read.

negative_control.result: reference pickup disabled; measurement withheld and comparison not claimed

limitations: Geometric 18 mm grasp gate then mocap attachment; contact forces and slip are not validated.
RGB is a rendered material proxy, not a camera or physical sensor measurement.
Poses and bench coordinates are illustrative, not physically calibrated.
